source_quotes: file link ALWAYS runs first and captures the non-semantic (structural / native) graph; the walk adds the intelligence on top; both know the other's current state
overlap_check: Built-in method_41 (new nodes link through relationship paths first) and method_24 (incremental layering reconciliation) are the closest; neither covers the link/walk ledger. Draft 26 is the per-modality call graph rule. New.

payload.name: Link Captures the Structure First, the Walk Adds Intelligence on One Shared State
payload.description: File link always builds the structural graph first. A walk reuses it by content hash and adds its own layers beside it. Both read one ledger under one lock, so there is never a second graph or a stale view.

principles.name: One state, two writers
principles.description: Two actors that each keep their own view of a graph will drift; one shared record and one lock keep them agreed.

principles.name: Layers do not overwrite
principles.description: Structure and meaning are separate layers; adding one never rewrites the other.

heuristics.condition: a graph for the same content exists twice
heuristics.action: look for a path that built without claiming the shared ledger row

heuristics.condition: a layer written by one actor disappears after the other updates
heuristics.action: check that the update carries the other's fields over

decision_rules.name: Link captures structure first
decision_rules.condition: a file is linked, changes or is found at boot
decision_rules.outcome: build the structural graph first as its own task and record it in the shared ledger keyed by content hash

decision_rules.name: The walk reuses by hash
decision_rules.outcome: claim the path, reuse the graph built for this content hash when its container still exists, otherwise build it with its own calls and record it

decision_rules.name: One lock, never two graphs
decision_rules.condition: the link worker and a walk touch the same path
decision_rules.outcome: take the shared per-path lock; the later one waits, never fails open and never builds a second graph

decision_rules.name: Layers stay separate
decision_rules.condition: the walk adds meaning to a structural graph
decision_rules.outcome: append to the semantic layers, which are append-only; never rewrite structural fields; keep derived structural sidecars, such as cross-file call resolution, unread and unwritten by semantic steps

decision_rules.name: Changed content is a new instance
decision_rules.condition: the content hash differs from the recorded one
decision_rules.outcome: build a new graph and a new task marked as a rerun of the old one; completed work stays final

decision_rules.name: A dangling graph is rebuilt
decision_rules.condition: the ledger names a graph whose container is gone
decision_rules.outcome: treat it as absent and rebuild; never keep a dangling id

decision_rules.name: Show both states
decision_rules.condition: a view or endpoint shows a file's graph
decision_rules.outcome: show the structural state, who created it, the semantic layers and the previous task exactly as stored
